## Why This Is Asked
This question tests the ability to design a tenant-isolated, privacy-conscious inference service at scale. It evaluates understanding of drift detection, model selection, controlled rollouts, and cost optimization—critical skills for building production ML systems in enterprise environments.

- **PrivateLink and VPC Isolation**: Ensure per-tenant network isolation and data residency compliance
- **Per-tenant Routing, IAM, and Data Residency**: Separate tenant traffic, enforce access controls, and meet regional compliance requirements
- **Drift Monitoring**: Use SageMaker Clarify to detect data drift, feature attribution drift, and model quality degradation
- **Canary Rollouts & Rollback**: Gradual traffic shifting with automated triggers based on latency p99, error rates, and custom metrics
- **Cost Model**: Estimate based on instance hours, inference calls, and data transfer; use multi-model endpoints to reduce GPU costs by 40-60% for lower-traffic tenants

## Why This Is Asked
This question tests the ability to design a low-latency NLP deployment on AWS with PrivateLink, focusing on practical choices (model size, endpoint sizing, canary rollouts) and operational concerns (privacy, bias/drift monitoring). It also probes cost awareness and understanding of private-data pipeline validation.

## Key Concepts
- SageMaker DistilBERT-lite or similar compact transformer
- PrivateLink and VPC data governance
- Canary rollouts with autoscaling policies
- SageMaker Clarify for bias detection and data drift
- Data privacy: PII redaction in preprocessing

## Code Example
```python
def redact_pii(text: str) -> str:
    """Redact PII using regex patterns."""
    patterns = {
        r'\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b': '[SSN]',
        r'\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b': '[EMAIL]',
        r'\b\d{10}\b': '[PHONE]',
    }
    for pattern, replacement in patterns.items():
        text = re.sub(pattern, replacement, text)
    return text
```

|-----------|----------------------|
| ml.m5.xlarge endpoint (on-demand, ~$0.23/hr) | $165 |
| SageMaker Clarify (monitoring) | $50 |
| Data transfer (PrivateLink) | $20 |
| S3 storage & requests | $10 |
| **Total** | **~$245/month** |
